title: SWF: ActionScript on-frame scripts compilation
description: Ensure frame scripts (Frame.script) compile to DoAction tags in the SWF output. Verify compile.ts emits DoAction (tag 12) with the compiled AS2 bytecode for each keyframe that has a non-empty script. Tests: a single-frame SWF with a script emits tag 12 containing ActionPush + ActionTrace bytes. Multi-frame: only frames with scripts get DoAction.
